cards.title: NPC 城主
cards.code:
local avatar_big = self.city_meta.avatar_big
local appearance = LocalController:instance():tryGetLine(LuaEntry.Player:GetABTestTableName(TableName.HeroAppearance), toInt(avatar_big))
if appearance ~= nil then
    local lord_icon_path = LoadPath.HeroIconsSmallPath .. appearance.queue_icon_path
    -- name = 城主名字
    if appearance.name ~= nil and appearance.name ~= "" then
        -- city_npc_lords_name_first--铁獠帝国 {0}
        self.owner_name:SetLocalText("city_npc_lords_name_first", Localization:GetString(appearance.name))
    else
        self.owner_name:SetText("")
    end
    -- queue_icon_path = 城主头像图标
    self.player_show:ShowDummyIcon(lord_icon_path, "Assets/Main/Sprites/UI/UILord/HeadFrame_dummy_citylord.png")
    self.appearance_gender = appearance.gender
end
